Location: Any Saksoft Location/ Hybrid 

Experience: 6+ years




About the role
We are looking for a hands-on engineer who enjoys building real solutions and working directly with clients. You will work on client-facing engineering projects and also contribute reusable solutions and accelerators to our Centre of Excellence (CoE). The role spans application development, AI/GenAI, cloud, DevOps and platform engineering.




What you will do

Build and deliver client-facing applications and engineering solutions
Work with client teams to understand their requirements and turn them into working solutions
Develop APIs, microservices, integrations and cloud-native applications
Build and integrate GenAI solutions such as LLM applications, RAG pipelines, AI agents and model APIs
Create PoCs, reusable components and accelerators for the CoE
Deploy and run solutions on AWS, Azure or GCP
Support CI/CD, containerization, deployment automation, monitoring and observability using Docker, Kubernetes and modern DevOps practices
Troubleshoot application, integration, cloud and deployment issues
Contribute to platform engineering and automation initiatives
Follow engineering, security, coding and architecture standards
Collaborate with Technical Architects, AI Engineers, DevOps, Cloud, Data and Platform teams



What we are looking for

5-7 years of software/application development experience with strong hands-on coding
Proficiency in Python and/or Java, .NET or Node.js
Experience with REST APIs and microservices
Experience building and deploying enterprise applications
Hands-on exposure to at least one cloud platform (AWS / Azure / GCP)
Working knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes and CI/CD
Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases and Git
Experience with, or strong interest in, GenAI engineering: LLM applications, RAG, vector databases and AI agents
Basic understanding of security concepts such as IAM, OAuth, SSO and RBAC
Exposure to monitoring and observability tools
Comfort working directly with client teams and solving problems across development, integration, deployment and support



Ideal profile
An engineer who can code, build PoCs, integrate systems, troubleshoot deployments and contribute to scalable, reusable solutions.
